interface.shortDescription: Look up IANA ports, media types, HTTP status codes and fields, URI schemes, enterprise numbers, and BCP 47 language tags; check RFC status; search and read any IANA registry.
interface.longDescription: Answers protocol-parameter questions from the IANA registries and the RFC record. Seven lookups cover service names and port numbers, media types (with the file-extension and intended-usage statements of the registration template, when it makes them), HTTP status codes, HTTP field names, URI schemes, Private Enterprise Numbers by number or OID, and BCP 47 language tags, which are validated and canonicalized subtag by subtag. Two more tools find any registry in the IANA protocol index and read its records, such as TLS cipher suites, DNS resource record types, or CBOR tags. A tenth reports the current status and relations of up to 10 RFCs, Internet-Drafts, or BCP/STD/FYI series from the RFC Editor and the IETF Datatracker. Every source is keyless, each registry response carries the registry's own last-updated date, and registrant contact details are never returned.
